title: Observability: wolfCrypt error code discarded before reaching framework log
description: All provider xlat_err() functions (wolfssl_cbc_xlat_err, wolfssl_gcm_xlat_err, wolfssl_sha_xlat_err, wolfssl_hmac_xlat_err, wolfssl_cmac_xlat_err) silently translate the wolfCrypt error code and return without logging. The framework then logs only the translated kernel errno (e.g. -EIO or -EACCES). The original wolfCrypt error code (e.g. FIPS_DEGRADED_E, AES_BLOCK_SIZE_E) is permanently lost. A support engineer seeing 'update failed: -5' (EIO) cannot determine whether the root cause was a block-alignment error, a DRBG failure, or a late FIPS degradation without attaching a debugger. File: src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_aes_cbc.c wolfssl_cbc_xlat_err (and equivalent in gcm, sha, hmac, cmac). Fix: each xlat site that maps to EIO or EACCES should pr_err_ratelimited the original wc_err before translating.
